query_evidence.question: ORACLE B2 for scenarios Q11
query_evidence.sql:
WITH m(month, ms, me) AS (VALUES ('2026-04','2026-04-01T00:00:00Z','2026-05-01T00:00:00Z'),('2026-05','2026-05-01T00:00:00Z','2026-06-01T00:00:00Z'),('2026-06','2026-06-01T00:00:00Z','2026-07-01T00:00:00Z'),('2026-07','2026-07-01T00:00:00Z','2026-08-01T00:00:00Z'),('2026-08','2026-08-01T00:00:00Z','2026-09-01T00:00:00Z'),('2026-09','2026-09-01T00:00:00Z','2026-10-01T00:00:00Z')),
co AS (SELECT event_id, event_at, triggering_paywall_event_id FROM user_events WHERE event_name = 'checkout_started'),
att AS (SELECT checkout_event_id, count(*) n FROM transactions WHERE checkout_event_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1)
SELECT m.month,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM co WHERE co.event_at >= m.ms AND co.event_at < m.me) AS checkouts,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM co WHERE co.event_at >= m.ms AND co.event_at < m.me AND co.triggering_paywall_event_id IS NULL) AS checkouts_without_paywall_link,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM co JOIN att ON att.checkout_event_id = co.event_id WHERE co.event_at >= m.ms AND co.event_at < m.me AND att.n > 1) AS checkouts_with_retries,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM co LEFT JOIN att ON att.checkout_event_id = co.event_id WHERE co.event_at >= m.ms AND co.event_at < m.me AND att.checkout_event_id IS NULL) AS checkouts_without_payment_attempt
FROM m ORDER BY m.month
